purpose: Continuously recover files/media/artifacts without letting automatic organization destroy provenance.
law: INDEX → HASH → TAG → REVIEW → ROUTE. Automatic move/delete is last, never first.

stages.operation: read filesystem metadata; emit path/size/time/type/hash index
group byte-identical files by size + content hash
stages.rule: Never delete duplicate groups automatically during recovery. Choose canonical copy only after lineage/path context is visible.

stages.operation: add searchable tags/fields over existing paths
stages.rule: Prefer overlay to forced folder taxonomy; a file may belong to multiple lineages.

stages.operation: photo/video search, similarity, faces, duplicate review
stages.rule: Use for media once originals/external-library semantics are understood; not as the universal file canon.

stages.operation: watch known ingress folders; rename/tag/move using deterministic rules
stages.rule: Enable only rules that have already survived dry-run/review. No AI-generated destination may become an automatic move rule without explicit promotion.
Suggestions never mutate source files. Treat semantic similarity as review evidence, not duplicate proof.

canonical_record.identity_rule: Content hash identifies exact bytes; project/artifact identity is a separate semantic layer and must not be collapsed into the hash.

excluded_initially: moving originals into a new universal taxonomy
promotion_gate: A routing rule becomes automatic only after at least one review pass shows no lineage/provenance damage and its inverse/recovery path is known.
